description: This file defines a report parser class for generating cost ledger reports related to account analytics in Odoo, including methods for fetching and calculating account balances and transaction details.

classes.name: account_analytic_cost_ledger
classes.description: A report parser class for generating cost ledger reports, providing methods to retrieve and process account analytic line data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the report parser with context and updates local context with helper methods and data.

methods.name: _lines_g
methods.description: Fetches general account lines within a date range and computes debit/credit based on balance.

methods.name: _lines_a
methods.description: Fetches analytic line details for a specific general account and account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_debit
methods.description: Calculates total debit amount for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_credit
methods.description: Calculates total credit amount for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _account_sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates net balance (debit minus credit) for an account within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_debit
methods.description: Sums debit amounts across multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_credit
methods.description: Sums credit amounts across multiple accounts within a date range.

methods.name: _sum_balance
methods.description: Calculates net balance across multiple accounts within a date range.
